coder_notes: KH617 is the only investigational agent (given alone in one experimental arm and with TMZ 5/28 in another); mechanism not stated. TMZ coded soc_backbone in the KH617+TMZ arm; it also appears in the investigator's-choice comparator arm on a 7/7 schedule (comparator role there). Trial-level regimen = combination because one experimental arm includes TMZ; the KH617 arm is monotherapy. Cisplatin/carboplatin + etoposide are comparator-only options within the TPC arm. Arm label for comparator taken as 'TPC: TMZ or Platinum (cisplatin or carboplatin)+VP-16'. MGMT-unmethylated is an entry requirement but not candidate-matched per manual.
